signal: KlariVis announced a partnership with INSBANK, a $1B Nashville institution (Jan 2026), continuing its run after crossing 100 customers and a $11M Series B

email.body1:
Heather, saw KlariVis just signed INSBANK and keeps stacking wins after crossing 100 clients.

Growth like that usually means more community banks and credit unions evaluating you than the team can reach before interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for KlariVis off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Heather, quick follow-up for KlariVis.

After a Series B and rapid customer growth, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings KlariVis needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Heather, last bit of proof for KlariVis.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how KlariVis's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Heather, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything in a fast-growth stretch, and I know it keeps you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a banking-software motion? I will tailor it to KlariVis either way.
